about.subtitle: My Story
about.title: My Story
about.paragraph1: My journey in software began with a spark of curiosity from a magazine article. After building my initial programming foundation in Python, I embraced various technologies not just to learn them, but as powerful tools to solve real-world engineering problems.
about.paragraph2: Along the way, I practiced native mobile development with Kotlin, explored 3D systems and physics optimization with Unity, and architected robust backend services using FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Each project served as a gateway to translate theoretical CS principles into scalable software.
about.paragraph3: Today, I view Artificial Intelligence as a transformative force multiplier. With my primary focus on Applied AI and LLM-driven systems, I build resilient digital products backed by modern web and mobile infrastructures.

projects.name: TicaretApp
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack e-commerce platform built with FastAPI and PostgreSQL, featuring JWT authentication, optimized REST APIs, and a modern React frontend.
projects.problem: Building a scalable full-stack e-commerce solution with modern architecture.
projects.solution: TicaretApp is a modern full-stack e-commerce platform. Built on a powerful backend API developed with Python FastAPI. Manages product, user, and order data with PostgreSQL database. On the frontend side, a user-friendly and dynamic interface is created using React and TypeScript. In this project, I worked in-depth on REST API design, database architecture, and component-based frontend development.

projects.name: Perpetua
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered personalized language acquisition platform leveraging the OpenAI API and advanced prompt engineering for dynamic content generation.
projects.problem: Creating an adaptive language learning experience powered by artificial intelligence.
projects.solution: Perpetua is an AI-powered language learning application. It offers personalized lessons that adapt to users' learning styles and pace. Features like text generation, translation, and conversation practice using OpenAI API. The project aims to make language learning more interactive and efficient. Backend is developed with FastAPI, frontend with React.

projects.name: ZigZag
projects.shortDescription: Dynamic 3D arcade platformer developed in Unity & C#, emphasizing physics engine optimization and clean OOP architecture.
projects.problem: Designing an engaging and replayable mobile platform game.
projects.solution: ZigZag is a 3D platform game developed using Unity 3D game engine and C#. Players try to keep their character alive on constantly changing and randomly generated platforms. The project focuses on dynamic level design, game physics, animation management, and mobile game optimization. It offers an enjoyable gaming experience with smooth gameplay mechanics.
